comparisons.peer_topic: Client CPU product launches and performance
comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, Intel launched Intel Core Ultra Series 1 (first with integrated NPU for AI workloads) and the power-efficient Intel Core Ultra 200V Series. Additionally, the 13th and 14th Gen Intel Core processors continued to serve a significant majority of client sales.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclosed specific desktop CPU product launches and architectural features for 2024. AMD highlighted the launch of the Ryzen 9000 series featuring Zen 5 cores and 3D V-Cache for gaming performance, while Intel highlighted the Intel Core Ultra Series 1 as its first product with an integrated neural processing unit for AI workloads. Both companies emphasized advanced architectural innovations (Zen 5/3D V-Cache for AMD; NPU integration for Intel) to drive their client CPU portfolios in the same fiscal year.

sentences.text: We launched the Ryzen 9000 series processors featuring "Zen 5" cores, along with X3D models featuring 2nd generation AMD 3D V-Cache™ technology for leadership gaming performance.

▪Client CPUs. In 2024, we ramped sales of the Intel® Core™ Ultra Series 1, our first product with an integrated neural processing unit for efficient processing of AI workload. The Intel Core Ultra Series 1, manufactured on the Intel 4 process, introduced the first AI PCs to the market. We also launched the Intel Core Ultra 200V Series, showcasing power efficiency and long-lasting battery life. The 200V Series, manufactured by an external foundry, leverages our Xe2 GPU architecture, bringing improved efficiency, second-generation ray tracing units and XMX AI acceleration to thin and light notebooks. During 2024, a significant majority of our client sales consisted of our 13th and 14th Gen Intel Core processors, manufactured on Intel 7, which allow us to serve the breadth of customer and computing needs in the client market.

comparisons.peer_summary: Intel launched a suite of edge computing processors including the Intel Core Ultra 200S Series, which integrates NPU IP into desktops to reduce package power while utilizing advanced performance and power-efficient cores with the latest packaging technology.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclosed specific desktop processor launches with advanced caching or AI features in 2024. AMD specifically mentioned the launch of Ryzen 9000 series X3D models featuring 2nd generation 3D V-Cache technology for gaming, while Intel announced the Intel Core Ultra 200S Series for edge computing/desktops that brings NPU IP to desktops. Both disclosures focus on new silicon generations with specialized technologies (3D V-Cache vs NPU) targeting performance efficiency in desktop platforms.

sentences.text: We launched the Ryzen 9000 series processors featuring "Zen 5" cores, along with X3D models featuring 2nd generation AMD 3D V-Cache™ technology for leadership gaming performance.

▪Edge computing. We recently launched a suite of processors for edge computing. This includes the Intel Core Ultra 200S Series, bringing the NPU IP to desktops and reducing package power. These hybrid designs utilize our most advanced performance cores and power-efficient cores, as well as the latest packaging technology.
